name: 23325 · Chesapeake, VA
findings: ZIP 23325 (Chesapeake) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23325 (Chesapeake) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23325 (Chesapeake) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
